header: NOT A SIGNAL, NOT A GATE — research only (Rule #10)
asked: I felt like all the explosive growth stocks and Bondes stocks have grown a great extent I exited the CRDO today but can you look in to this more?

gate.claim: the shipped explosive-read study measured +0.45pp median lift, CI [-0.31,+1.36]

exit_reference.note: his fill today is not stored in the app — the reference is the close on the date above

ledgers.caveat: 09-14 / 09-12 = day-one backfill: 'present on that day', not 'arrived'.

biases.look_ahead: strict=True on every quoted cell: a filing available ON the cross-section is excluded; refuse_lookahead asserts the '>' case
biases.survivorship: the universe is the audit price pickle's membership = today's; DELISTED names are absent by construction
biases.print_anchoring: an ARRIVE event is measured from the first cross-section AFTER the filing became available, never on it
biases.derived_q4: unfiled quarters are assumed available at end+90d (core.prep_fin 'plus90'); derived='drop' is the sensitivity
biases.overlapping_windows: cross-sections are 21 sessions apart, so h=63/126 forwards overlap 3x/6x — date CIs use boot_blocks(block=h//21) and n_dates is printed per cell
biases.static_sectors: the sector axis is today's GICS from `companies`, applied to past bars

notes.price_cache: prices.load_prices may fetch+write the parquet cache for a cold symbol; the ledgers (growth_seen, bonde_seen, growth_board) are never written.
notes.pre_filed_126: contains the earnings reaction and any pre-release run
notes.filed: SEC 10-Q/10-K filing date; press-release / 8-K dates are not in this panel
